items.claim: Note path frame data dropped from Boolean result

items.note: The SVG export's own white test was folded into the same `isDefaultBackground`, along with the legacy-background load check. The export's regex also missed 4-digit `#ffff`.

items.claim: CommandBar story registers a hand-picked subset of app actions
Swatch None toggle and Swap skip the selection
items.note: Swap commits as one undo entry. The `/`, `X`, and `D` keys still change only the active paint. Their actions can't reach the selection edit, and the files are outside this area, so this is filed as a P3 in `docs/TODO.md` ("draw's color keys change only the next shape's paint…").

items.claim: Second Alt-click on Hidden/Collapsed sets every row
items.note: The existing test asserted the buggy result under the title "shows every piece"; it is corrected, and a Collapsed case is added.

items.claim: Setting a swatch to None skips the selection
items.note: duplicate of the A+B swatch finding, fixed in fd43e856d2

items.claim: Pathfinder read page-local geometry as world, so a boolean across pages came out wrong
items.note: It needed 01f007866f first, a fix in core: `sceneNodeOutline` read text at its stored pose even though outlines are world space. That change narrows its parameter from any `{ get }` to a `Scene`, so its changeset is `major` with a before/after snippet. Draw's outlines adapter shares the world reads, so it now stores its results in the parent's frame as well.

items.claim: Layer chip sampled a gradient in RGB and ignored the paint's opacity
items.note: Solid and tile chips now fade by opacity too.

items.claim: An empty-text sticky note got a blank Layers row
items.note: A blank or whitespace-only label or text now falls back to the node id, and measurement rows get the same treatment.

items.claim: Turning machine-font outlines off left the 350 and 950 weight faces registered
items.note: It now unregisters what `listFontOutlines()` actually holds for each enrolled family.

items.claim: Copy loupe color stayed enabled and copied a stale hex after the loupe hid or the lens unmounted
Pathfinder's compareZ rebuilt and scanned the whole render order on every comparison
items.note: The same code was in the kit's `booleansAdapter` dep in editing, and I fixed it there too. There is a new core export, `renderOrderCompare`: it ranks the cached `renderOrderNodes()` once per structural edit. I updated `exports.inventory.json` for it, and it has a changeset of its own.

items.claim: Fonts unreliable probe (`document.fonts.check` answers true for absent families)
Layers panel throws on an unknown path-effect kind (`effectNodeName`), and a `toString` kind labels the row "toString"
Swatch "none" toggle copies `toggleFocusedNone` instead of sharing it
items.note: (the context gains `toggleNone(slot)`, which the swatch and the `/` key both call)
